C1390.title: Mirai Botnet DDoS Attack on Dyn DNS Service
C1390.summary: In late 2016, Mirai used large numbers of infected IoT devices to launch major DDoS attacks affecting multiple high-profile targets. The current references support that Mirai formed a botnet from devices such as IP cameras and home routers and caused large-scale attack impact, but exact claims about the October 21, 2016 Dyn incident, affected services such as Twitter and Netflix, and the U.S. East Coast scope should be supported by authoritative Dyn incident sources.
